svg.title: Cosmic Ascendant — Weight of the Stars. Draft 1 / Cosmic Ascendant classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Celestial Alignment forks into Collapsing Star then Supernova Unbound, or Searing Starlight then Light of Dead Stars. Gravity Well forks into Event Horizon then Heart of the Singularity, or Stellar Siphon then Hunger of the Void. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Cosmic Ascendant jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

Its only Damage row is Cosmic Explosion (50 at level 25, 60 AP), so burst here is exposure first: Cosmic Intent and Cosmic Chains each carry a 35% Increase Damage Taken row that lists all four stat types with no element and therefore amplifies essentially every hit the target takes. Decrease Damage Taken sits on three separate 40 AP jutsu (Chains 35%, Energy 35%, Aura 30%, all 2 rounds on a 7-round cooldown), which is the broadest tag in the kit and the Defensive trait's engine. Cosmic Intent is the signature A-rank cast (IDT 35%, Afterburn 35%, Lifesteal 40% in one 40 AP action), so its burn and its leech are offered as two rival capstones a player cannot own together."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Celestial Alignment","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"When the stars fall into line, the enemy is laid bare and the ascendant burns brighter.","coverage_note":"IDT 35% -> 37% on Cosmic Intent and Cosmic Chains (enemy, 2 rounds, 40 AP); IDG 35% -> 37% on Cosmic Energy (self, inside its circle).","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Cosmic Ascendant","scope":"Cosmic Ascendant jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Cosmic Chains","Cosmic Energy","Cosmic Intent"],"effect_rows":3}},{"id":"02","name":"Collapsing Star","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["01"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"damage","flat":3,"display_role":"DAMAGE"}],"flavor":"A star does not go quietly. Void"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: two Foundations each fork into two Hidden -> Advanced routes. Celestial Alignment (IDT on Intent and Chains, IDG on Energy) opens the Damage route (Collapsing Star -> Supernova Unbound) and the Afterburn route (Searing Starlight -> Light of Dead Stars); Gravity Well (DDT on Chains, Energy, Aura; DDG on Aura) opens the DDT route (Event Horizon -> Heart of the Singularity) and the Lifesteal route (Stellar Siphon -> Hunger of the Void). IDG and DDG sit only on Foundations and capstones.","Calibration: single-row Damage is 3/3 (+6, the guardrail) because Cosmic Explosion is the kit's only damage row and the route reaches one jutsu where Taiyo's +5 reaches three (per-row +12% against +10-12.5%). Three-row DDT is 2/2/3 (+7) against Taiyo's single-row +10; two-row IDT tops out at +5 (Foundation +2 plus one capstone +3), under the two-row +7 lesson. Afterburn is 3/7 (+10) and Lifesteal 3/5 (+8, 48%). Row-weighted strongest build is 32 (01+06+07+08) on 10 rows against Taiyo's 31 on 9.","Passives and main tree: the bloodline IDG passive (25% + 0.15/level on Earth, Fire, Lightning, None, Wind; Highest) multiplies the enhanced Explosion downstream. Both IDT rows and the IDG row list all four stat types with no element, so they match every element-less hit and elemental hits of any listed stat type: the exposure amplifies allies', weapon and normal-jutsu damage on that enemy; Energy's IDG raises the caster's normal jutsu in the circle. Lifesteal includes pierce; other tags skip it.","Delivery and uptime: all five jutsu have a 7-round cooldown and cost 40 AP except Cosmic Explosion (60 AP, range 4). Every buff and debuff row lasts 2 rounds. Cosmic Energy is an EMPTY_GROUND circle: its IDG and DDT reach the caster from the round after the spawn and only while standing on its tiles (its move row sorts last). Intent has range 5, Chains and Aura 4. Three DDT rows on three casts allow a Chains -> Energy -> Aura rotation for near-continuous mitigation. Ranked modes skip skills.","Fourth-purchase choices: after any 3 BP route the natural fourth is the other Foundation. Unadvertised legal builds include 01+02+04+05 (burn with +3 Damage and 40% exposure, no mitigation), 01+02+03+04 (burst with 38% Afterburn), 06+07+08+09 (pure fortress: DDT +7, IDG +3, Lifesteal +3) and 06+07+09+10 (tank-siphon: Lifesteal +8, DDG +5, DDT +4). No-capstone hybrids such as 01+02+06+07 (+3 Damage, +4 DDT, +2 IDT/IDG/DDG) are legal; all 14 allocations are non-dominated, every node used.","Four examples are given because each capstone answers a different trait or role with its own Advanced Art: Damage (Burst), Afterburn (pressure), DDT (Defensive) and Lifesteal (sustain); the two Intent capstones are deliberately rivals. User-owned tuning left open: Supernova Unbound +3 vs +2 Damage (route +6 vs +5); Heart of the Singularity +3 vs +2 DDT (three-row route +7 vs +6); whether Light of Dead Stars should carry IDT given the burst capstone already does."],"risks":["Classification: no row in the kit carries an element (every damage, buff and debuff row is element-less), so no existing element can isolate it; a bloodline-keyed classification extension is required, not a bare element label. Targeting 'None' would reach every non-elemental row in the game. Collision with normal jutsu under such a label is unverified (no non-bloodline row catalog).","Resolver: under the current resolver all 10 supported rows fall back to None; nothing in this tree is reachable exclusively today. The tree assumes the proposed whole-kit classification and the bloodline-keyed label; the engine status is proposal_requires_resolver_adjustment_and_classification_extension.","Exposure breadth: both IDT rows list Bukijutsu, Genjutsu, Ninjutsu and Taijutsu with no element, so getEfficiencyRatio matches essentially every non-pierce hit the target takes from anyone for two rounds. The +5 ceiling (40% on two 40 AP casts) is therefore a team-wide amplifier, not a bloodline-only one. Pierce hits are not amplified by IDT, DDT, IDG or DDG.","Afterburn: the +10 route is one application row on a single-target 40 AP cast; its value is downstream on every non-pierce hit that one enemy takes for two rounds, capped at 60% of each hit, so other Afterburn sources saturate quickly. The kit has only one damage row of its own to feed it (Cosmic Explosion); the rest comes from weapons, normal jutsu and allies. Not simulated.","Lifesteal: the route tops out at 48%, twelve points under the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage leech budget shared with vamp; vamp from the normal tree or items can saturate the cap and waste part of the +8. It needs both combatants alive and is blocked by healprevent on the caster. The kit's own feed is one 60 AP damage row plus pierce from normal jutsu or weapons.","Ground circle: Cosmic Energy's IDG and DDT are self-targeted rows on an EMPTY_GROUND spawn, so they reach the caster only from the round after casting and only while standing on the tiles; Heart of the Singularity's +3 IDG and part of its +3 DDT are positional. No ally-hazard rows exist (the harmful rows are all SINGLE-method on OTHER_USER casts).","Stacking: BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is true at the pin, so these potency effects stack with any other potency source; the combined budget with a future normal-tree potency policy is unaudited. The bloodline IDG passive multiplies the enhanced Explosion, and 2-round DDT buffs on three 40 AP casts can be overlapped; neither was modelled.","No combat simulation: non-dominance of the 14 allocations and the row-weighted totals are arithmetic over per-row additions, not evidence of equal combat strength. The Burst route reaches one jutsu (Explosion, 60 AP) and is lowest by row weight (24), so its +6 Damage sits at the guardrail by design. Shield, Wound and move rows are unsupported. No adverse, hidden, gated or injected rows."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":5,"decreasedamagetaken":7,"afterburn":10,"lifesteal":8},"supported_rows_in_kit":10,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"afterburn":1,"damage":1,"decreasedamagegiven":1,"decreasedamagetaken":3,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":2,"lifesteal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["afterburn","damage","decreasedamagegiven","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","lifesteal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Cosmic Ascendant classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Cosmic Ascendant jutsu inherit Cosmic Ascendant potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. g.text: Draft 1 / Cosmic Ascendant classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Cosmic Ascendant jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Light of Dead Stars path + Gravity Well
Heart of the Singularity path + Celestial Alignment
Hunger of the Void path + Celestial Alignment
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · LS: Lifesteal
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
